description: This file defines the class Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Extension.Opencart.Currency.ECB, which handles fetching and processing currency exchange rates from the European Central Bank and updating the local currency data in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class in the OpenCart system responsible for updating currency exchange rates from ECB data feed.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches the latest currency rates from the ECB, parses the XML response, updates the system currency data, and clears relevant cache.
